page.notes: The "rium" at the foot right is treated as a catchword; its reading is uncertain. Several right-margin references (Sent. e. 10., Cap. 8. f. 8. §. 6., Tuiss. cen.) and the left-margin "Iack." are doubtful and marked [?]. A reference mark (a small symbol) stands in the text beside the line "Hæc effata" and is not transcribed as a word. The printed "s" has been rendered as s throughout. The running head is read as printed, with the word spacing and capitals as seen.
